sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For generations, our foundry has valued the strong roots and long-standing partnership we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable planning stability for both our companies. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to offer €51.30 for the extended 24-month term.

Specifically, our Angebot includes a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

My team and I remain deeply proud of the work we do for you, and we look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
